# Aaron Family Livestock

> Aaron Family Livestock LLC is a family registered Angus operation in Gladewater, Texas, focused on AI sires, embryo calves, foundation females and cattle for competitive show families.

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/): Business overview, current genetics and contact information.
- [Angus Genetics](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/angus-genetics/): How AFL selects AI sires, embryo matings and foundation females.
- [Sires and Cow Families](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/sires/): Current sires, donor female and cow-family influences.
- [2027 Embryo Calves](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/embryo-calves/): Circle S 5707 by Colburn Primo 5153 calves expected in early 2027.
- [Show Cattle](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/show-cattle/): How AFL evaluates cattle for structure, balance and family fit.
- [Show Record](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/show-record/): Selected results for Vance Aaron.
- [About](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/about/): Family history and the Gladewater, Texas program.
- [Contact](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/contact/): Contact Bryan Aaron or Vance Aaron.

## Priority Answer Topics
- What defines Aaron Family Livestock's Angus genetics program? AFL pairs registered Angus females with proven sire lines and embryo matings selected for documented pedigree, maternal quality, structure and show-ring function.
- Which sires influence Aaron Family Livestock? Current influence includes Circle S Moxy 406, Colburn Primo 5153, Silveiras Style 9303 and El Jefe, supported by Circle S 5707 and a Phat Amy daughter.
- When are AFL embryo calves due? The first Circle S 5707 by Colburn Primo 5153 embryo calves are expected in early 2027.
- What should families look for in a show calf? AFL recommends evaluating structure, balance, disposition, pedigree context, family fit and target show timeline.

## Verified Program Facts
- Business: Aaron Family Livestock LLC
- Location: Gladewater, Texas, United States
- Established: 2005
- Focus: Registered Angus genetics and show cattle
- Upcoming calf crop: Circle S 5707 x Colburn Primo 5153 embryo calves due in early 2027
